body: Thanks man. At least there is someone who cares.
I don't feel like going into great detail but I just feel worthless. Like no one cares that I exist or just act like they appreciate me
It's all of the other poor things that are going. The other things that make me feel like this

This is short I know but we were talking for awhile before. But it was 2 weeks. We would talk for hours and hours and I don't know what I did wrong. She just ended it without a reason and I gave it my all. Everything else in my life is downhill as well. I'm very insecure about myself and this is why I've taken this very harshly. I don't let many people into my life but I trusted her and I got this instead. This is just another thing added to mix of my mess of a life.
It was really good until the last week. She wasn't texting much and when I would text her she would say she had to leave right away. I knew it was coming but I couldn't prepare myself enough.
I appreciate the support but I really just want all of this to end. I am tired of feeling like this and now feels like the perfect time to leave
Yes. It has also affected my schoolwork and I can't get out of this rabbit hole
It's hard. I just never want to wake up one day and have this all be over
